contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [TR POT VIII/VIIII IMPV] COS III, S C ; D/ L VERVS AVG ARM [PARTH] MAX

A copper-alloy Sestertius of Lucius Verus (AD 161-169) (Reece period 8). Reverse legend reads [TR POT VIII/VIIII IMPV] COS III, S C. Reverse shows Aequitas standing left, holding scales and cornucopiae. Mint is Rome (AD 168-169). See RIC vol.III, p.330-331, no.1479 & 1484. Obverse legend reads L VERVS AVG ARM [PARTH] MAX.
